This notebook documents the original `ME3_Exact_Enrichment_Run` implementation. The selected ME3 regions have nominal P < 0.05 and a positive mutant-minus-control concentration difference. Overlapping intervals are merged, with a maximum merged width of 50 kb. Variants are filtered by overlap with both ATAC and strong GENOA intervals after hg38-to-mm10 lift-over.

The primary analysis compares numbers of regions containing at least one variant under repeated balanced downsampling. It is **not** a shuffled-label permutation test. Native analysis code is in `R/variant_analysis.R`; it is the selected class from the original notebook, with exploratory alternatives and local execution paths omitted. The default render only reads the saved results.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE)) {
  params <- list(recompute = FALSE)
}
candidate_roots <- c(".", "..")
repo_dir <- candidate_roots[vapply(
  candidate_roots, function(path) file.exists(file.path(path, "R", "common.R")),
  logical(1)
)][1]
stopifnot(!is.na(repo_dir))
repo_dir <- normalizePath(repo_dir, winslash = "/")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  eval = isTRUE(params$recompute),

  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE
)
```

## Saved configuration and results

The filtered source sets contain 3,260 case and 1,880 control variants. Sampling uses 80% of the smaller group, capped at 5,000; the effective sample size is therefore 1,504 per group per replicate. There are 1,000 replicates and the seed is 1234. Threshold k means more than k variants per region; k=0 is the primary criterion.

```{r saved-configuration-and-results, eval=TRUE}
table_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "data", "source_tables", "Fig6_KC")
parameters <- read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "6h_Resampling_parameters.csv"))
statistics <- read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "6h_Variant_statistics.csv"))
parameters
statistics
```

## Native analysis dependencies

This chunk is disabled by default. Input variant and lift-over files must be supplied explicitly; the notebook does not contain account credentials or machine-specific paths.

```{r native-analysis-dependencies}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(
  {
    library(R6)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(GenomicRanges)
    library(IRanges)
    library(GenomeInfoDb)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(data.table)
    library(readr)
  }
)
source(file.path(repo_dir, "R", "variant_analysis.R"))
variants_file <- Sys.getenv("CORTEX_VARIANTS_TSV")
liftover_chain <- Sys.getenv("CORTEX_LIFTOVER_CHAIN")
stopifnot(
  file.exists(variants_file),
  file.exists(liftover_chain)
)
```

## Original analysis call

The constructor below records the selected analysis settings. The implementation also checks input columns and harmonizes sequence levels. A normal render does not call `run_all()`.

```{r original-analysis-call}
analysis <- ME3_Exact_Enrichment_Run$new(
  me3_diffbind_path = file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "H3K27Me3_FTneg_Modality_H3K27Me3_PeakSet_me3_expand_bed_5000_Condition_FlashtagNeg__genotype_DBA_DESEQ2.csv"
  ),
  atac_path = file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "Supp_Table_1_ATAC_master.csv"
  ),
  genoa_path = file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "GENOA", "atac_idr_peaks_merged_uniform_genoa_strong_0.5-distal_and_proximal-mm10.bed"
  ),
  variants_tsv_path = variants_file,
  liftover_chain_path = liftover_chain,

  n_null_reps = 1000L,
  downsample_to = 5000L,
  downsample_frac = 0.8,
  rand_seed = 1234L,

  verbose = TRUE
)
analysis$run_all()
results <- analysis$get_results()
```

## Empirical one-sided tail

The recorded primary tail is (number of replicates with case-minus-control region count <= 0 + 1) / (number of replicates + 1). The following inexpensive calculation checks the saved replicates; it does not draw new subsets.

```{r empirical-one-sided-tail, eval=TRUE}
replicates <- read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "6h_Variant_null_replicates.csv"))
primary <- replicates[replicates$k == 0, ]
stopifnot(
  nrow(primary) == 1000
)
empirical_tail <- (sum(primary$diff <= 0) +
  1)/(nrow(primary) +
  1)
empirical_tail
```
